title: Production content policy still allows images from localhost
steps: curl -I https://nodbusiness.vercel.app/landing: img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http://localhost:3001 http://localhost:3002.
expected: Development hosts only in development builds.
impact: Low: lets pages load images from the visitor's own localhost; a sign of environment mixing.
fix: Add the localhost sources only when NODE_ENV !== "production".
